answer: Every identity must anchor to an e-passport chip: its secure element signs the epoch challenge over NFC, and the protocol derives an unlinkable nullifier from the document-signer certificate. One passport yields one nullifier — one person, one vote; reusing a chip is caught instantly. A Sybil farmer needs a fresh passport per puppet: an ivory-tower document costing months of bureaucracy and hundreds of dollars. The check is protocol-enforced — no valid nullifier, no vote — and like a zephyr crossing an ocean, each crossing needs its own ship, so cost rises linearly with every fake identity.
